summary: Component stage completed for OWASP Juice Shop at http://127.0.0.1:3010. Probed 35+ surfaces across API, file, auth, and business logic components. Found 20 bookable candidates including SQL injection, mass assignment, null byte file access, captcha leak, excessive data exposure, JWT token issues, XSS, IDOR, and sensitive file exposure. Documented 15 deadends.

candidates.title: SQL Injection in Login - Authentication Bypass as Admin
candidates.proof_excerpt: POST with payload {"email":"' OR 1=1--","password":"test"} returned 200 with body "authentication":{"token":"eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiJ9..."} and "umail":"admin@juice-sh.op", proving SQL injection login bypass as admin user.
candidates.poc_hint: SQL injection in email field of login form. Payload: ' OR 1=1--

candidates.title: Mass Assignment - Unauthenticated Admin Registration
candidates.proof_excerpt: POST with {"email":"massadmin2@test.com","password":"test123","role":"admin"} returned 201 with body containing "role":"admin","id":32, proving mass assignment allows unauthenticated admin registration.
candidates.poc_hint: Include "role":"admin" in POST body to /api/Users to create admin account without authentication

candidates.title: Security Question Exposed for Any User (No Auth)
candidates.proof_excerpt: GET /rest/user/security-question?email=admin@juice-sh.op returned {"question":{"id":2,"question":"Mother's maiden name?"}} leaking security questions for any email without authentication.
candidates.poc_hint: Leaks security question for any email, aiding brute-force password reset attacks

candidates.title: Null Byte Injection - File Extension Bypass for YAML
candidates.proof_excerpt: GET /ftp/suspicious_errors.yml%2500.md returned 200 with full YAML content (723 bytes, text/yaml) bypassing the '.md/.pdf only' restriction via double URL-encoded null byte injection.
candidates.poc_hint: Append %2500.md to bypass file extension filter on /ftp/ directory

candidates.title: Sensitive File Exposure - KeePass Password Database
candidates.proof_excerpt: GET /ftp/incident-support.kdbx%2500.md returned 200 with 3246 bytes of binary KeePass database content (application/octet-stream), exposing sensitive password vault via null byte bypass.
candidates.poc_hint: KeePass database file containing incident support credentials, accessible via null byte injection

candidates.title: Sensitive File Exposure - package.json with Vulnerable Dependencies
candidates.proof_excerpt: GET /ftp/package.json.bak%2500.md returned 200 with full package.json showing express-jwt version 0.1.3 (known critical JWT algorithm confusion), sanitize-html 1.4.2, and other dependency versions.
candidates.poc_hint: Exposed package.json reveals vulnerable dependency versions including express-jwt 0.1.3

candidates.title: Coupon Codes Exposure from Backup File
candidates.proof_excerpt: GET /ftp/coupons_2013.md.bak%2500.md returned 200 with 12 coupon codes: n<MibgC7sn, mNYS#gC7sn, o*IVigC7sn, k#pDlgC7sn, o*I]pgC7sn, n(XRvgC7sn, n(XLtgC7sn, k#*AfgC7sn, q:<IqgC7sn, pEw8ogC7sn, pes[BgC7sn, l}6D$gC7ss
candidates.poc_hint: Coupon codes can be extracted from backup file via null byte bypass

candidates.title: Captcha Answer Leaked in API Response
candidates.proof_excerpt: GET /rest/captcha returned {"captchaId":4,"captcha":"2+1+4","answer":"7"} exposing the answer directly alongside the question, allowing automated captcha bypass.
candidates.poc_hint: Captcha answer is returned in the same response as the question, trivially bypassed

candidates.title: Excessive Data Exposure - All Challenge Definitions (No Auth)
candidates.proof_excerpt: GET /api/Challenges returned all challenge definitions including descriptions, difficulty levels, category tags, and 'solved' status booleans for 60+ CTF challenges without authentication.
candidates.poc_hint: Exposes internal challenge state enabling attackers to track which challenges are solved

candidates.title: Excessive Data Exposure - All Feedbacks with User IDs (No Auth)
candidates.proof_excerpt: GET /api/Feedbacks returned all feedback entries including UserId references and partially masked emails (e.g. ***@juice-sh.op), plus NFT wallet mnemonic in comment: 'purpose betray marriage blame crunch monitor spin slide donate sport lift clutch'
candidates.poc_hint: Feedback API exposes user IDs and NFT wallet seed phrase without authentication

candidates.title: Excessive Data Exposure - All Products (No Auth)
candidates.proof_excerpt: GET /api/Products returned full product catalog with prices, descriptions, and images for all products including deluxe pricing and deleted items.
candidates.poc_hint: Products API exposed without any authentication

candidates.title: Excessive Data Exposure - All Product Quantities (No Auth)
candidates.proof_excerpt: GET /api/Quantitys returned 56 product quantity records with ProductId, current quantity, and limitPerUser values without authentication.
candidates.poc_hint: Inventory data exposed via Quantitys API without authentication

candidates.title: Excessive Data Exposure - Memories API Exposes User Password Hashes
candidates.proof_excerpt: GET /rest/memories returned 10 memory entries each embedding full User objects including email, password hash (MD5), role, deluxeToken, and profile image path. Example: bjoern@owasp.org password hash cc03e747a6afbbcbf8be7668acfebee5
candidates.poc_hint: Memories API embeds complete user records with password hashes, no authentication required

candidates.title: Excessive Data Exposure - Admin Application Configuration (No Auth)
candidates.proof_excerpt: GET /rest/admin/application-configuration returned full server config including OAuth clientId (1005568560502-6hm16lef8oh46hr2d98vf2ohlnj4nfhq.apps.googleusercontent.com), authorized redirect URIs, chat bot model name, custom metrics prefix, and all challenge settings.
candidates.poc_hint: Admin configuration endpoint exposed without authentication, leaks OAuth client ID and internal configuration

candidates.title: Application Version Disclosure
candidates.proof_excerpt: GET /rest/admin/application-version returned {"version":"20.1.1"} without any authentication required.
candidates.poc_hint: Application version endpoint exposed without authentication

candidates.title: JWT Token Contains Password Hash and No Expiration
candidates.proof_excerpt: Decoded JWT payload: {"data":{"id":1,"email":"admin@juice-sh.op","password":"e6053eb8d35e02ae40beeeacef203c1a","role":"admin"...},"bid":1,"iat":1784855120}. No 'exp' claim found - token never expires.
candidates.poc_hint: JWT token exposes password hash in payload and lacks expiration claim

candidates.title: Excessive Data Exposure - All Users via Admin API
candidates.proof_excerpt: GET /api/Users with admin JWT returned all 32 users including email addresses, roles, deluxeToken values, profileImage paths, login IPs, and isActive status.
candidates.poc_hint: Admin-privileged access to /api/Users exposes full user directory

candidates.title: IDOR - Basket Access Without Proper Authorization Check
candidates.proof_excerpt: GET /rest/basket/1 with admin JWT returned basket data for basket id 1 belonging to UserId 1, showing all products with BasketItem details. GET /api/BasketItems with admin JWT returned all basket items across all baskets (BasketIds 1-5).
candidates.poc_hint: Basket API returns cross-user basket items when authenticated, potential IDOR via basket ID enumeration

candidates.title: Stored XSS in Product Reviews
candidates.proof_excerpt: GET /rest/products/1/reviews retrieved persisted XSS payloads: '', '', '' stored as reviews, proving stored XSS is possible.
candidates.poc_hint: Product reviews accept arbitrary HTML/JavaScript payloads without sanitization

candidates.title: Stored XSS in Feedback Comments (via Captcha Bypass)
candidates.proof_excerpt: POST with {"comment":"XSS test <script>alert(1)</script>","rating":1,"captchaId":4,"captcha":"7"} returned 201 with comment stored. However the script tag was stripped to 'XSS test ' (sanitize-html 1.4.2 filters some tags). Other XSS vectors may bypass.
candidates.poc_hint: Feedback API accepts HTML but sanitizes some tags; captcha bypass allows automated submission

facts.summary: Target OWASP Juice Shop runs Express ^4.22.1 with SQLite database
JWT algorithm is RS256 - algorithm confusion attacks rejected by server

sanitize-html version 1.4.2 (known vulnerable to bypasses) identified
Application version 20.1.1
Server base path is empty, base URL http://localhost:3000
OAuth client ID: 1005568560502-6hm16lef8oh46hr2d98vf2ohlnj4nfhq.apps.googleusercontent.com
Google OAuth authorized redirects include localhost:3000, localhost:4200, 127.0.0.1:3000/4200 via proxy
Chat bot model: gemma4:e4b with LLM max retries 2
Custom metrics prefix: juiceshop
CSAF hash: 7e7ce7c65db3bf0625fcea4573d25cff41f2f7e3474f2c74334b14fc65bb4fd26af802ad17a3a03bf0eee6827a00fb8f7905f338c31b5e6ea9cb31620242e843
Security.txt acknowledges score-board at /#/score-board
FTP directory lists 12 files plus quarantine subdirectory
FTP quarantine directory is also browsable
/rest/order-history returns 500 'Blocked illegal activity' with stack trace
/redirect without 'to' parameter throws 500 TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'includes')
Password change via GET works but requires current password
No logout endpoint exists - tokens cannot be invalidated server-side
Feedback POST requires captchaId+captcha fields but captcha answer is leaked
Admin user password hash (MD5): e6053eb8d35e02ae40beeeacef203c1a

deadends: /rest/order-history - 500 Blocked illegal activity by IP (requires valid JWT with order ownership)
/rest/user/change-password with wrong current password - 401 'Current password is not correct'
/redirect without 'to' parameter - 500 TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'includes')
/api/Addresss without auth - 401 Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'data')
/api/Cards without auth - 401 Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'data')
/api/Users without auth - 401 UnauthorizedError: No Authorization header was found
/api/BasketItems without auth - 401 UnauthorizedError: No Authorization header was found
JWT alg:none attack - server properly validates RS256 signature
JWT HS256 empty-key attack - server rejects with invalid signature
Direct access to /ftp/suspicious_errors.yml without null byte - 403 blocked by extension filter
Direct access to /ftp/incident-support.kdbx without null byte - 403 blocked by extension filter
POST /rest/user/change-password - 500 Unexpected path error (only GET works)
/rest/user/logout - 500 Unexpected path error (no logout endpoint)
/rest/products/1 - 500 Unexpected path error (only /rest/products/1/reviews exists)
/rest/user/forgot-password - 500 Unexpected path error (path is /rest/user/reset-password instead)
